explanation: Area grows with the square of the width, so one 30 cm pizza has about 707 cm² of pizza, while two 20 cm pizzas have only about 628 cm² between them.

claims.text: A circle 30 cm across has an area of about 707 cm² (pi times 15 squared).
Two circles 20 cm across have a combined area of about 628 cm² (2 times pi times 10 squared).
The area of a circle grows with the square of its diameter.
